labels.label: ECHO
labels.setup: You're so slow on the uptake, the echo finishes before you answer.

labels.label: DRAWER
labels.setup: Your big entrance has the elegance of trousers caught in a drawer.

labels.label: FIRST
labels.setup: You want the last word before you've thought of the first.

labels.label: SHOW
labels.setup: You're a rehearsal that somehow got an audience.

labels.label: TICKETS
labels.setup: You say yes so often I could sell tickets to your nod.

labels.label: ARROW
labels.setup: You couldn't follow an arrow without asking which way it points.

labels.label: TABLE
labels.setup: You have the presence of a table that needs clearing.

labels.label: ENTRY
labels.setup: Your idea of an entrance is getting stuck sideways.

labels.label: HANGER
labels.setup: Your posture could make a coat hanger give up.

labels.label: SKETCH
labels.setup: You're what happens when the rough sketch takes itself seriously.

labels.label: CURTAIN
labels.setup: You'd hang a curtain over the door and call the room finished.

labels.label: TASTE
labels.setup: You think good taste is whatever fits on your plate.

labels.label: INQUIRY
labels.setup: You made carrying a panel look like a public inquiry.

labels.label: ONEHAND
labels.setup: I could have done that with one hand tied behind my back.

labels.label: DOORWAY
labels.setup: You'd ask for directions while standing in the doorway.

labels.label: PICTURE
labels.setup: You're a demonstration of why instructions have pictures.

labels.label: FRIENDS
labels.setup: Without your friends, you'd still be wedged in that doorway.

labels.label: USEFUL
labels.setup: You think standing near useful people makes you useful.

labels.label: SPEECH
labels.setup: Some people know when a speech has gone on long enough.

labels.label: TOAST
labels.setup: You call that a toast? I've had wind with more ceremony.

labels.label: DEBATE
labels.setup: You turn every simple instruction into a discussion.

labels.label: SUPPER
labels.setup: You'd forget your own supper if nobody put your name on it.

labels.label: POINT
labels.setup: You couldn't keep to the point if it was marked on the floor.

labels.label: DUST
labels.setup: Your idea of responsibility is handing someone a cloth.
